_comment: Accepted dead-control findings (HC2 guard, check-dead-controls.js). Each entry is a finding the team has consciously accepted, with a reason. The guard fails the build ONLY on findings NOT listed here. Key shape: { check, block, attr, reason }. To accept a finding add it here with a reason; to fix one, wire or remove the control and delete the entry. Empty `accepted` = zero tolerance. CRITICAL: never raise the baseline silently — any increase must include a written reason (see check-element-manifest-conformance.js:796-798).

accepted.reason: False positive, not a real dead control (verified 2026-09-04, D948 golden-colour Phase 3). render.php DOES read this attribute every request, inside the post_grid_text_rows foreach loop (render.php ~line 606-617): "$post_grid_gradient = $attributes[ $post_grid_attr . 'Gradient' ] ?? '';" builds the literal attribute name at RUNTIME by string concatenation, so the static scanner never sees the literal token 'titleColourGradient' etc in the file text -- same dynamic-key false-positive class already documented for sgs/product-card's descFontFamily/priceFontFamily/priceNoteFontFamily (block-file-consistency-baseline.json). Confirmed via php -l + a manual trace of the loop, not just re-asserted.
